name: git-workflows
description: Isolate task worktrees and write reviewable commits and pull requests with verified context and repository privacy.

interface.shortDescription: Isolated task worktrees, reviewable commits and pull requests.
interface.longDescription: Keep repository tasks in their own worktrees, resume the right workspace, preserve unfinished work, and write reviewable commits and pull requests.
defaultPrompt: Commit the intended changes as small, reviewable commits.
